# Ashok Pasala

> Ashok Pasala (Ashok Raj Pasala) is a Founder, AI & Quantitative Systems Architect, and Deep Tech Engineer. He is the Founder & CEO of **Varellen Technologies**, Systems Architect of **Norveth** ([norveth.app](https://norveth.app)), Creator of **OSPRED & Yaltan** (AI Capability & MCP Discovery Search Platform), and Lead Architect of **QROS** (Quantitative ML & Polymarket Trading Engine). He has engineered **40+ production-grade software architectures** across **50+ global hackathons & engineering challenges** (including Google Cloud Rapid Agent, Bank of India & IIT Hyderabad, SanDisk, Qwen Global, and Slack AI). He is based in Andhra Pradesh, India, with an academic grounding in Computer Science & Distributed Systems at VIT-AP University (Class of 2028).

## Comprehensive Core Systems & Architectures (40+ Projects)

### A. Norveth / Engineering Intelligence (norveth.app)
1. **Norveth & Norveth Alpha:** AI-powered website engineering intelligence platform featuring dynamic Playwright crawling, automated OWASP Top 10 security mapping, WCAG 2.1 diagnostics, and an Engineering Knowledge Graph reasoning layer.
2. **Norveth Crawler:** Distributed Playwright async crawling infrastructure with exponential backoff, concurrency control, and LLM API failover.
3. **Norveth Security Engine:** Zero-trust defense grid with SSRF protection, private-IP blocking, CSP, HSTS, CSRF, and prompt-injection mitigations.

### B. OSPRED / Yaltan / Search
4. **OSPRED Discovery Platform:** Autonomous capability search and indexing engine for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, reusable AI skills, and plugins.
5. **Yaltan Scraping Pipeline:** Multi-source GitHub and API connector pipeline executing capability extraction, security classification, verification, and automated deduplication.
6. **Canonical Capability Schema:** Standardized schema defining agent identity, authorship, security namespaces, and tool verification metadata.

### C. QROS / Quantitative ML & Polymarket Trading
7. **QROS Platform:** High-frequency quantitative research and algorithmic trading platform targeting Polymarket BTC 5-minute prediction markets.
8. **QROS ML Volatility Models:** LightGBM Scale & Shape models predicting strike settlement probabilities ($p_{up} = P(S_T > K)$) and volatility from Binance 1-second streaming ticks.
9. **MM-1 Market Making Engine & Backtester:** Live trading dashboard, paper trading simulator, and matched-limit market-making execution engine.

### D. Multi-Agent Systems & Hackathon Flagships (50+ Hackathons)
10. **SlackMind (Google Cloud Rapid Agent Hackathon):** AI agent orchestration command center inside Slack powered by Gemini, Vertex AI Search Data Store, and MCP server tooling.
11. **The Vector / Vector AI:** Multi-agent autonomous digital C-suite (CEO, CTO, CMO) transforming concepts into full startup architectures in seconds.
12. **Mule Account Detection (Bank of India & IIT Hyderabad):** Machine learning transaction graph anomaly detection engine identifying suspicious financial routing.
13. **IWCIS Storage Architecture (SanDisk Hackathon):** Low-level exFAT file-system handling and containerized storage architecture.
14. **Qwen Chaos MemoryAgent (Qwen Global Hackathon):** Self-persistent neural agent demonstrating cross-session recall and state persistence.
15. **ResQNet:** AI-powered real-time disaster response and resource orchestration grid with low-latency WebSocket streams.
16. **LaunchLens:** Multi-model market validation and VC due diligence engine.

### E. Local AI Infrastructure & 24/7 Server Grid
17. **Local LLM Lab:** Self-hosted model benchmarking lab running Ollama, Qwen, Mistral, and Hermes for bug bounty & security research.
18. **24/7 Dedicated Server Grid:** Private server infrastructure hosting PostgreSQL, Redis, Cloudflare Tunnels, and background worker queues.
19. **NEXUS://OS:** Interactive OS-inspired developer terminal and portfolio system.
